//: ABS validation: brake-and-steer (steerability under maximum brake).
//1: Standard automotive validation test: drive straight, brake hard,
//2: and demand a steering input simultaneously.  Without ABS the front
//3: wheels lock; locked tires can't generate lateral force, so the car
//4: plows straight regardless of steering input.  With ABS the fronts
//5: modulate, retain enough lateral grip to follow the steering input,
//6: and the car curves.  This is the scenario where ABS earns its keep
//7: from a STEERING perspective rather than a stopping-distance one.
//10: Reads yaw_drift_deg and pos_y in the report to quantify how much
name: abs_brake_and_steer
